description:
Current sales, discount codes and Man of Many's deal roundups (Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Christmas).

    Use when someone asks about sales, deals, discount codes or where to buy for less. Returns Man of
    Many's recent deal articles plus live offers and coupon codes from its Australian retail partners.

limit.description: Number of deal articles to return, 1 to 15. Default 10.
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Optional product, brand or retailer to filter deals on, e.g. "headphones", "Apple", "The Iconic". Omit for all recent deals.
query.title: Query

name: deals
title: Deals
